title: Fairness Concerns in App Reviews: A Study on AI-based Mobile Apps

bias_targets.methodology: Applying a machine learning classifier to filter fairness-related mobile app reviews, followed by K-means clustering and manual qualitative analysis to identify user complaints about disparities in feature quality, updates, and access across different platforms or devices (e.g., iOS vs. Android).

Applying a machine learning classifier and clustering technique on mobile app reviews to identify user complaints regarding linguistic discrimination, marginalization, and lack of support for specific languages.

Using NLP text classification and K-means clustering on app reviews to extract user reports of gender discrimination, such as app features and filters being exclusively designed for or favoring one gender.

Using NLP text classification and K-means clustering on app reviews to identify instances where users felt excluded, targeted, or unfairly banned by an app's AI based on their race or physical appearance.
Using NLP text classification and clustering on app reviews to capture user complaints regarding apps failing to accommodate or recognize diverse sexualities.
Using NLP text classification and clustering on app reviews to identify user perceptions of biased algorithmic censorship, demonetization, and content promotion based on political views.

Using NLP text classification and clustering on app reviews to identify complaints about unfair, non-transparent advertisement and subscription policies that disproportionately exclude lower-income users or users from developing nations.
